fields.label: Core problem
fields.value: Package applications into isolated, portable environments while sharing operating-system resources and coordinating those environments at cluster scale.

fields.label: Mechanism chain
fields.value: Application dependencies/configuration -> container artifact/runtime -> isolated process environment -> shared kernel -> orchestration -> cluster management -> scaling/observability.

fields.label: Central insight
fields.value: Containerization is not merely packaging software. In the supplied source it is a layered system spanning virtualization boundaries, application packaging, standardized images/runtimes/distribution, orchestration and cluster operations, with a distinct shared-kernel security model.
